title: The relative Hilbert stack maps faithfully to the absolute one
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Prove the forgetful 1-morphism H_d(X/Y) -> H_d(X) is faithful: faithfulness is checked on fibre categories; for two objects xi = (U, Z, y, x, alpha), xi' = (U, Z', y', x', alpha') over U and two morphisms (g, b, a), (g', b', a') in the fibre over U, the images agree iff g = g' and a = a'; the commutative diagram with vertical arrows b|_Z, b'|_Z and F(a) = F(a') then forces b|_Z = b'|_Z, and since Z -> U is finite locally free of degree d the covering {Z -> U} is an fppf covering, so the sheaf property gives b = b'.
